payload.title: install over a pre-CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR host wraps the old status line worker
payload.body: After claude-config-dir the status line worker command the claude adapter writes is sh "${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/personas/_session/cratylus-status-line.sh". ensureBadgeStatusLine (packages/forge/src/deploy/status-line.ts) takes a statusLine command that is neither that string nor starts with it for the host's own, so a re-install over a host installed before the change would wrap the old worker command (sh "$HOME/.claude/personas/_session/...") as if it were the host's, and a session would print the badge twice. Read from the code, not run. Uninstall of such a host is unaffected (it restores from the recorded placed/host pair). Open: should install recognise the superseded spelling (an adapter-declared prior command) and replace it in place?
